summary: SDK bundle triggers keyword co-occurrence rules without corroborating exfiltration behavior
details: @magda/semantic-indexer-sdk ships a bundled dist/index.js that contains multiple POST call sites and a token matching 'dyndns'. These are keyword co-occurrences in a large minified SDK bundle and do not themselves identify a hardcoded attacker-controlled C2 destination, environment-variable scraping, credential-path reads, or install/import-time execution. No lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content are present, and no named installer secret is traced to a non-first-party endpoint. The matches are consistent with normal SDK HTTP client code and incidental substring occurrences rather than exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
